title: Kissed Yeasty Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A yeasty and juicy Syrian dish featuring lamb, perfect for a energizing meal, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot. This recipe is onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware pot to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yeast, olive oil, lemon juice, paprika, salt, black pepper, and cumin.
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the yeast mixture.
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the preheated ttukbaegi earthenware pot and cook for 20 minutes.
Turn the skewers over and cook for an additional 15 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the pot and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Traditionally, Syrian kebabs are served with a side of rice or flatbread.
You can also serve with a side of roasted vegetables or a salad.
